# Future-ReadyMeetingSpacesMadeSimple

![Two people in a Microsoft Teams Room hosting a hybrid meeting with remote participants.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Accordion-Express-Install-Jabra-PanaCast-50-VBS.jpg)

### AVI-SPL and partners LG, Jabra, Microsoft, and Salamander make it easier for IT teams to deploy consistent, scalable meeting rooms with less effort.

#### A Smarter Way to Roll Out Meeting Rooms

Managing meeting room technology across multiple offices takes time and coordination.

Standardized, ready-to-deploy solutions make it easier.

With AVI-SPL and its partners, IT teams can create modern meeting spaces that look, feel, and perform the same everywhere.

[READ THE LG SOLUTION STORY](https://pages.avispl.com/hubfs/2025/2025%20pdf%20assets/AVI-SPL%20LG%20Deploy%20Future-Ready%20Meeting%20Spaces%20with%20Ease.pdf)

#### What You’ll Learn

- How bundled solutions speed deployment and reduce complexity
- How standard designs create consistent user experiences
- How Microsoft Teams Rooms fit into a unified approach
- How AVI-SPL supports planning, installation, and long-term scalability

#### Technology That Works Together From Day One

LG displays, Jabra cameras, Microsoft Teams Rooms, and Salamander furniture come together in one cohesive design. AVI-SPL integrates everything into a single solution that delivers reliability and consistency in every space.

[READ THE ARTICLE](https://pages.avispl.com/hubfs/2025/2025%20pdf%20assets/AVI-SPL%20LG%20Deploy%20Future-Ready%20Meeting%20Spaces%20with%20Ease.pdf)

#### Plan Your Rollout With AVI-SPL

Whether you are upgrading a few spaces or scaling across multiple sites, AVI-SPL can help design and deliver meeting room solutions that fit your goals. Connect with our experts to plan a deployment that grows with your organization. [Connect with our team today](https://avispl.com/contact-us/).
